name: dart
description: Connect Dart to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use Dart MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect Dart to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with tasks and project docs using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my Dart workspace.
Find anything in Dart that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review tasks and project docs in Dart.
